item.title: Single-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation System
item.description:
Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application that ingests Kubernetes troubleshooting documentation, converts document chunks into embeddings, stores vectors in Qdrant, and generates grounded responses using a locally hosted LLM via Ollama.

Tech Stack
#

Python • LangChain • Ollama • Qwen2.5-Coder • Sentence Transformers • Qdrant • RAG

Key Features
#

  • Document loading and chunking
  • Semantic embeddings generation
  • Vector storage using Qdrant
  • Semantic similarity search
  • Context-aware prompt construction
  • Grounded question answering using a local LLM

Status: ✅ Completed

item.title: Single-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation System
item.description:
Overview
#

Kubernetes troubleshooting documentation is dense, scattered, and hard to search by keyword. This project builds a fully local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that lets an engineer ask natural-language questions — “Why is my pod stuck in CrashLoopBackOff?” — and get a grounded answer sourced directly from internal troubleshooting docs, with no data ever leaving the machine.
